simple.meaning: שְׁלָה (shᵉlâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “to be secure.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Daniel 4:1. The surrounding context includes kingship.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H7954. sheleh שְׁלֵה adjective at ease (Egyptian Aramaic Cooke 210 ); — ׳שׁ בְּ הֲוֵית Dan 4:1 I was at ease in my house. — 3:29 see following.
